Interface ProxyExecutionListener

All Known Subinterfaces:
ProxyMethodExecutionListener
All Known Implementing Classes:
CompositeProxyExecutionListener, LastExecutionAwareListener, ObservationProxyExecutionListener, ProxyMethodExecutionListenerAdapter
public interface ProxyExecutionListener
Listener interface invoked when a proxy method or query is executed.

Tadaya Tsuyukubo

  • Method Details

    • beforeMethod

      default void beforeMethod(MethodExecutionInfo executionInfo)
      Called before every method invocation.

      Exception handling: Exceptions thrown by this method are dropped and do not affect the original subscription's publisher flow. Such exceptions are reported to Hooks.onErrorDropped(java.util.function.Consumer).

      Parameters:
      executionInfo - method execution context

    • beforeQuery

      default void beforeQuery(QueryExecutionInfo execInfo)
      Called before executing a query (Batch.execute() or Statement.execute()).

      Note: this callback is invoked when the publisher produced by execute() is subscribed, not when execute() itself is called.

      Exception handling: Exceptions thrown by this method are dropped and do not affect the original subscription's publisher flow. Such exceptions are reported to Hooks.onErrorDropped(java.util.function.Consumer).

      Parameters:
      execInfo - query execution context

    • afterQuery

      default void afterQuery(QueryExecutionInfo execInfo)
      Called after executing a query (Batch.execute() or Statement.execute()).

      The callback order is:

      • beforeQuery(QueryExecutionInfo)
      • eachQueryResult(QueryExecutionInfo) for the first result
      • eachQueryResult(QueryExecutionInfo) for the second result
      • ...
      • eachQueryResult(QueryExecutionInfo) for the Nth result
      • afterQuery(QueryExecutionInfo)
      QueryExecutionInfo.getExecuteDuration() is available in this callback and contains the duration since beforeQuery(QueryExecutionInfo).

      Note: this callback is invoked when the publisher produced by execute() is subscribed, not when execute() itself is called.

      Exception handling: Exceptions thrown by this method are dropped and do not affect the original subscription's publisher flow. Such exceptions are reported to Hooks.onErrorDropped(java.util.function.Consumer).

      Parameters:
      execInfo - query execution context

    • eachQueryResult

      default void eachQueryResult(QueryExecutionInfo execInfo)
      Called while processing each query Result.

      This callback is invoked once per result while query results are being processed.

      QueryExecutionInfo.getCurrentMappedResult() contains the mapped result.

      Exception handling: Exceptions thrown by this method are dropped and do not affect the original subscription's publisher flow. Such exceptions are reported to Hooks.onErrorDropped(java.util.function.Consumer).

      Parameters:
      execInfo - query execution context
